reply: {"restatements": ["The Requirements Tool is required to deliver a requirements visualization that shows things from a high-altitude, whole-picture perspective.", "A zoomed-out, bird's-eye style visualization of requirements must be furnished by the Requirements Tool.", "It is obligatory that the tool used for requirements offers a requirements visualization of the distant-overview variety."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool may provide a \"1000-feet view\" kind of requirements visualization.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Every piece of source code, together with all documents connected to development, must be kept under a version control system.", "Version control is mandatory for all development-related documents and for all source code.", "A version control system must be applied to all source code and to every development related document."], "alteration": {"text": "Only source code shall be controlled under a version control system.", "element": "quantity"}}

{"restatements": ["Every NFL season must begin with the publication of the new System version.", "The new version of the System is required to be issued as each NFL season opens.", "Publishing the new System version at the start of every NFL season is mandatory."], "alteration": {"text": "New System version releases shall be released at the beginning of every other NFL season.", "element": "quantity"}}

{"restatements": ["After the current order has been confirmed, the system must present its itemized invoice in full.", "The system is required to show a detailed invoice covering the current order as soon as that order is confirmed.", "Following confirmation of the current order, a detailed invoice for it has to be shown by the system."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may display a detailed invoice for the current order once it is confirmed.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Inventory Quantity Adjustment documents must be produced by the System, derived from each product's daily sales figures together with that product's formulas.", "Working from product formulas and daily sales data per product, the System is required to create an Inventory Quantity Adjustment document.", "The System is obligated to build the Inventory Quantity Adjustment document using the daily sales data of the products and the products' formulas."], "alteration": {"text": "The System may generate Inventory Quantity Adjustment document based on product daily sales data and product formulas.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The source code of the Requirement Tool must be founded on open-source software components.", "All source code belonging to the Requirement Tool is required to derive from components of open-source software.", "Open-source software components shall serve as the basis for the Requirement Tool's source code."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirement Tool's source code should be based on open source software components.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["Users must be able to produce a Compliance Matrix document by means of the Requirements Tool.","Generating a Compliance Matrix document shall be supported by the Requirements Tool.","The Requirements Tool is required to make it possible to create a Compliance Matrix document."],"alteration":{"text":"The Requirements Tool may allow generating a Compliance Matrix document.","element":"modality"}}

{"restatements": ["After receiving the audit report, the user is required to input replacement ratings derived from it.", "The user must record a fresh set of ratings, drawing on the findings in the audit report.", "Using the audit report as the basis, the user is obligated to submit newly assigned ratings."], "alteration": {"text": "The user may enter new ratings based on the audit report.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["The process used to build the Requirements Tool must cover engineering the requirements for that tool itself.","Requirements engineering for the Requirements Tool must be part of how the tool is developed.","Developing the Requirements Tool obliges its developers to perform requirements engineering on the tool itself."],"alteration":{"text":"The Requirements Tool's development process may include the Requirements Tool's own requirements engineering.","element":"modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Whenever a user asks for assistance, the system must provide contextual help made up of hints and explanatory content that covers every screen and every element appearing on those screens.", "On request, the system is required to make available guidance and explanatory text addressing all screens and each individual item displayed within them.", "The system must, when requested, deliver help information containing tips and explanations for every screen and for every item those screens contain."], "alteration": {"text": "The system should have a help system that offers tips and explanation for each screen and each item on the screens upon demand.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Whenever a schedule changes, the system is required to inform the user.", "It is mandatory that the system alerts the user to every modification made to a schedule.", "The user must receive notification from the system for all schedule updates."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may notify the user of any schedule changes.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["PDF export of documentation content — covering both single documents and entire documentation trees — must be provided by the Requirements Tool.", "It must be possible to generate PDF versions of documentation content with the Requirements Tool, whether for one document or for a whole documentation tree.", "The Requirements Tool is required to offer PDF export capability for documentation content at both the single-document level and the full-tree level."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should support exporting documentation content to PDF, both individual documents and complete documentation trees.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["The claims adjuster is required to record the preferred repair shop in the estimate assignment.","The person handling the claim must input the preferred repair facility into the estimate assignment.","An estimate assignment must have the preferred repair facility entered by the adjuster."],"alteration":{"text":"The appraiser shall enter the preferred repair facility on the estimate assignment.","element":"actor"}}

{"restatements": ["To access the site, a customer is required to hold a valid login id.", "Entry to the site is permitted only for customers who possess a valid login id.", "A valid login id is a prerequisite for any customer seeking to enter the site."], "alteration": {"text": "Administrators must have a valid login id to enter into the site.", "element": "actor"}}

{"restatements":["Every individual who is relevant to the system—covering, though not restricted to, staff, students, lecture instructors, clinical lab instructors, and clinical site administrators—must have both an e-mail address and a phone number stored by the system.","The system is required to hold e-mail and telephone contact details for each person associated with it, and that population includes at minimum staff members, students, lecture instructors, clinical lab instructors, and clinical site administrators.","Contact information consisting of an e-mail address and a phone number has to be maintained in the system for the complete set of relevant people; staff members, students, lecture instructors, clinical lab instructors, and clinical site administrators are examples of who counts, and the set is not limited to them."],"alteration":{"text":"The system should contain contact information (e-mail and phone number) for all people relevant to the system, including (but not limited to) staff members, students, lecture instructors, clinical lab instructors, and clinical site administrators.","element":"modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Doorstop must link each change made to a requirement with the developer identifier that already exists.", "Whenever requirements are modified, Doorstop is required to tie that modification to a pre-existing developer identification.", "Doorstop has to connect requirement changes with an already-established developer ID."], "alteration": {"text": "Doorstop should associate requirements changes to existing developer identification.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Doorstop must offer a way to install it that is lightweight.", "An installation approach of low weight is required to be supplied by Doorstop.", "Installing Doorstop has to be achievable through a lightweight mechanism that the project provides."], "alteration": {"text": "Doorstop may provide a lightweight installation method.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The Requirements Tool must support checking requirements for conformance with the EARS syntax.", "Validating requirements against EARS syntax is a capability the Requirements Tool is required to offer.", "It must be possible to use the Requirements Tool to verify requirements against the rules of EARS syntax."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should provide capabilities for validating requirements according to the EARS syntax.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The user must be given the ability by the system to confirm the purchase.", "It is required that the system enable the user to carry out confirmation of the purchase.", "Confirmation of the purchase shall be made possible for the user by the system."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may allow the user to confirm the purchase.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["After a game has been started, the product must show a defensive grid to every player.", "The product is required to present a defensive grid to all players once game initiation has occurred.", "Following the start of a game, a defensive grid must be displayed by the product to each player."], "alteration": {"text": "Once a game is initiated the product may display a defensive grid to each player.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Concurrent use by at least six people must be supported by the system.", "The system is required to accommodate no fewer than six simultaneous users.", "At a minimum, six users must be able to operate the system at the same time."], "alteration": {"text": "The System shall allow for a minimum of 10 users to work at the same time.", "element": "quantity"}}

{"restatements": ["Doorstop must be able to scale to handle thousands of requirements.", "It shall be possible for Doorstop to scale up to thousands of requirements.", "Doorstop is required to scale so that it accommodates thousands of requirements."], "alteration": {"text": "Doorstop shall be scalable to support hundreds of requirements.", "element": "quantity"}}

{"restatements":["Every representative in cardmember services and in merchant services must make regular use of the Disputes application once they have completed the two-day training course.","Following completion of a two-day training course, all cardmember and merchant services representatives are required to use the Disputes application on a recurring basis.","The Disputes application has to be used routinely by the entire population of cardmember and merchant services representatives, after their two-day training is finished."],"alteration":{"text":"90% of the cardmember and merchant services representatives shall use the Disputes application regularly after a 2-day training course.","element":"quantity"}}

{"restatements":["Whenever a search is performed, the system must show every product that matches it.","It is required that the system present the complete set of products matching the user's search query.","All products corresponding to the search must be shown by the system."],"alteration":{"text":"The system shall display some of the matching products based on the search.","element":"quantity"}}

{"restatements": ["The Requirements Tool must support managing documents whose sections and chapters can be nested.", "Documents organized into nested chapters and sections have to be manageable through the Requirements Tool.", "It shall be possible, by means of the Requirements Tool, to manage documents that contain hierarchically nested sections and chapters."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool may allow management of documents with nested sections/chapters structure.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["A student may be withdrawn from a clinical lab section by either a Program Administrator or a member of the Nursing staff, and the system is required to permit this.", "The system must make it possible for Nursing staff members and Program Administrators alike to take a student out of a clinical lab section.", "Removing a student from a clinical lab section is an operation the system shall permit for users who are Program Administrators or who belong to the Nursing staff."], "alteration": {"text": "The system shall allow a Program Administrator, but not Nursing staff, to remove a student from a clinical lab section.", "element": "actor"}}

{"restatements": ["Out of the box, the user must be presented with meetings ordered from earliest time to latest.", "Absent any conflicting configuration, the system is required to list the user's meetings chronologically, soonest first.", "The default listing of meetings that the user receives is mandated to be sorted by time in increasing sequence."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may show the meetings to the user in ascending time order by default.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The Reverse Parent relationship must be accommodated by the Requirements Tool.", "It is mandatory for the Requirements Tool to provide capability for the Reverse Parent relationship.", "Support of the Reverse Parent relationship is an obligatory capability of the Requirements Tool."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should support the Reverse Parent relationship.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Doorstop is required to offer an interactive means of inspecting the items belonging to a document.", "An interactive capability for examining a document's items has to be supplied by Doorstop.", "Doorstop must make it possible for a document's items to be examined in an interactive manner."], "alteration": {"text": "Doorstop should provide a way to view document items interactively.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["A Web API interface must be offered by the Requirements Tool.", "The Requirements Tool is required to expose an interface accessible via Web API.", "It is mandatory that the Requirements Tool deliver a Web API-based interface."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should provide a Web API interface.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The product must make it possible to create, save, and edit the menus of products that point-of-sale terminals consume.", "The product is required to enable users to add, persist, and change the product catalog menus on which POS registers rely.", "It must be feasible through the product to input, retain, and amend product menu data serving point-of-sale devices."], "alteration": {"text": "The product may permit the entry, storage, and modification of product menus used by POS terminals.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["It must be capable of downloading the latest medical record.", "Downloading the most recent medical record has to be possible for it.", "It is required to have the ability to download the newest medical record."], "alteration": {"text": "It may be able to download the most recent medical record.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Users must be able to navigate the documentation tree by means of the Requirements Tool.", "The documentation tree has to be browsable through the Requirements Tool.", "Browsing the documentation hierarchy is an obligation the Requirements Tool is required to support."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should provide browsing of the documentation tree.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["It must be possible for a user to key in a phone number that support staff can dial to reach them.", "The system is required to provide a way for the user to supply a contact number at which support personnel can place a call.", "Users must be able to submit a telephone number through the system so that support staff have a number to call."], "alteration": {"text": "Support personnel shall be permitted to enter the contact number at which the user can be reached.", "element": "actor"}}

{"restatements": ["The system must let a user pick a language, provided that language is associated with one of the countries in the target market.", "Users shall be given the ability, through the product, to choose any language tied to one of the target market nations.", "It is required that the product permit the user to select a language, restricted to those used in the target market countries."], "alteration": {"text": "The product may allow the user to select a chosen language from one of the target market countries.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["In every environment, the product is required to operate on the hardware that is already in place.", "The product must execute on the pre-existing hardware in each and every environment.", "For every environment, running the product on hardware that is already present is mandatory."], "alteration": {"text": "The product may run on the existing hardware for all environments.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Requirement trees containing a minimum of 10,000 requirements must be supported by the Requirements Tool.", "It is mandatory for the Requirements Tool to handle requirement trees that hold no fewer than ten thousand requirements.", "The Requirements Tool is required to be capable of working with requirement hierarchies of 10,000 requirements or more."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool shall support requirement trees with at least 50000 requirements.", "element": "quantity"}}

{"restatements": ["How long the product needs for its first load must be governed by the quality of the internet connection available, and that connection quality is itself a function of the medium through which the product is executed.", "The duration of the product's initial loading is required to vary in line with connection strength, with connection strength in turn being determined by the medium used to run the product.", "Initial load duration for the product is obliged to depend on how strong the internet connection is, and that strength is itself contingent on the medium of running the product."], "alteration": {"text": "The product should take initial load time depending on internet connection strength, which also depends on the media from which the product is run.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The Requirements Tool must present identification details, among them a title, the release version, and hyperlinks to the project website.", "Identifying information — a title, the release version, and links to the project website among them — has to be supplied by the Requirements Tool.", "It is mandatory that the Requirements Tool furnish identifying data covering, at minimum, title, release version, and project website hyperlinks."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should provide identifying information, including title, release version, and project website links.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Doorstop must support bringing in content that originates in other requirements management tools.", "It is required that Doorstop be capable of ingesting material held in other requirements management tools.", "Importing content from third-party requirements management tools has to be possible in Doorstop."], "alteration": {"text": "Doorstop should be able to import content from other requirements management tools.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["Vehicle year, make, and model must be contained in the vehicle data.","The vehicle data is required to contain the vehicle's year, make, and model.","Vehicle data must encompass the year, make, and model of the vehicle."],"alteration":{"text":"The vehicle data should include vehicle year, make and model.","element":"modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Individuals serving as Program Administrators or as members of the Nursing Staff must be permitted to edit the details of a Clinical Lab Section, specifically the clinical site's name, the department or section, the class instructor, the lab's day and time, and the contact information.","The system must enable Program Administrators and Nursing Staff Members to change any Clinical Lab Section data, covering the clinical site name, the department/section, the class instructor, the lab day and time, and contact details.","Editing of Clinical Lab Section records — including clinical site name, department/section, class instructor, lab day and time, and contact information — must be available to Program Administrators and Nursing Staff Members."],"alteration": {"text": "Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members shall have the ability to delete information relating to a Clinical Lab Section including the clinical site name the department/section for the lab the class instructor day and time of lab and contact information.","element": "action"}}

{"restatements": ["After a game has begun, the system must prevent players allocated to that game from being chosen in the player list.", "Following the start of a game, the product is required to remove that game's assigned players from those the player list offers for selection.", "When a game has started, any player assigned to it must no longer be selectable in the list of players."], "alteration": {"text": "Once a game has been initiated the product may make the players assigned to the game unavailable for selection from the list of players.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["It shall be possible, through the Requirements Tool, to organize requirements residing in documents into a structured form.", "The Requirements Tool must be capable of giving requirements that appear in documents a structured arrangement.", "Requirements held within documents shall be structurable by means of the Requirements Tool."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should support structuring requirements in documents.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Menu creation and editing shall be restricted to those cafeteria staff whose names appear on the authorized Menu Managers list.", "Only cafeteria staff members recorded on the authorized Menu Managers list are permitted to add or modify menus.", "Creating or editing a menu is allowed solely when the person doing so is a cafeteria staff member named on the list of authorized Menu Managers."], "alteration": {"text": "The system shall permit only a single cafeteria staff member who is on the list of authorized Menu Managers to create or edit menus.", "element": "quantity"}}

{"restatements": ["Once a user submits a query, the resulting response must be displayed on the screen within 7 seconds.", "The system is required to have the answer to a submitted query visible on screen no later than seven seconds after submission.", "A query's response has to finish loading onto the display within 7 seconds of the user submitting it."], "alteration": {"text": "Responses to queries should take no longer than 7 seconds to load onto the screen after the user submits the query.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Ordinary personal computers must be able to run the Requirements Tool; hosting it on a bespoke cloud environment must not be a precondition for use.", "The Requirements Tool is required to work on standard consumer desktops and laptops, without depending on any purpose-built cloud deployment.", "It must be possible to use the Requirements Tool on everyday PC hardware, and no dedicated cloud hosting arrangement may be demanded in order to use it."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should be usable on the normal personal computers, e.g., it should not require a special cloud deployment.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The system must permit the user to choose the financing option.", "It is required that the system let the user pick the financing option.", "The system is obliged to enable the user's selection of the financing option."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may allow the user to select the financing option.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Programmatic access to data held in requirements shall be supplied by the Requirements Tool.", "The Requirements Tool is required to make requirements data reachable through a programmatic interface.", "It shall be possible to obtain requirements data by programmatic means from the Requirements Tool."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool should provide programmatic access to requirements data.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The system is required to employ SMTP as its mail protocol.", "SMTP must be the mail protocol that the system uses.", "It is mandatory that the system's mail handling rely on SMTP."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may use the SMTP mail protocol.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["The system must let the user pick which product they intend to configure.", "Users shall be able to choose the product that is to be configured, and the system is required to make that choice available.", "It shall be possible within the system for a user to designate the product targeted for configuration."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may allow the user to select the product to configure.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["The estimator must look for recycled components that are obtainable, consulting the roster of preferred parts vendors.","It is obligatory for the estimator to seek out second-hand parts that are available by reference to the list of favoured component suppliers.","The estimator is required to hunt for recycled parts that are available, using the register of preferred parts providers."],"alteration":{"text":"The estimator is permitted to look for available recycled parts by consulting a list of preferred parts suppliers.","element":"modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Access to the system component that connects to CampusConnect must be restricted to users who hold authorization.", "The CampusConnect-facing part of the system is to be reachable solely by users who are authorized.", "No party other than authorized users is permitted to reach the subsystem that interfaces with CampusConnect."], "alteration": {"text": "Only authorized users may have access to the portion of the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["It must be possible for the Requirements Tool to serve a substantial user population.","The Requirements Tool needs to have the capacity to accommodate a high number of users.","The Requirements Tool must be able to handle a large user base."],"alteration":{"text":"The Requirements Tool must be able to accommodate 10,000 users.","element":"quantity"}}

{"restatements":["Doorstop must offer a mechanism for displaying requirements in document form.","Users must be able to read requirements as a document through a capability that Doorstop supplies.","Doorstop is required to make requirements viewable in the form of a document."],"alteration":{"text":"Doorstop may provide a way to view requirements as a document.","element":"modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Modification of the display must be permitted by the system.", "The system is required to let the display be modified.", "It shall be possible to modify the display through the system."], "alteration": {"text": "The system may allow modification of the display.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["Meeting notifications must be deliverable by the product through multiple delivery mechanisms that the end user designates.","The product is required to support dispatching notifications about meetings over more than one channel chosen by the end user.","It must be possible for the product to notify people of meetings using several distinct methods, each as selected by the end user."],"alteration":{"text":"The product shall be able to send meeting notifications via a single end-user specified method.","element":"quantity"}}

{"restatements": ["The Requirements Tool must offer controls that enable requirement UIDs to be generated automatically.", "Automatic generation of requirements UIDs shall be achievable through controls supplied by the Requirements Tool.", "Users must be able to have requirement UIDs generated automatically by means of controls in the Requirements Tool."], "alteration": {"text": "The Requirements Tool may provide controls for automatic generation of requirements UIDs.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements": ["Doorstop must be capable of baselining requirement versions.", "Using Doorstop, it shall be possible to create baselines of requirement versions.", "Doorstop is required to support the baselining of versions of requirements."], "alteration": {"text": "Doorstop should provide the capability to baseline versions of requirements.", "element": "modality"}}

{"restatements":["Requirements content must be capable of being exported from Excel and imported into Excel by the Requirements Tool.","Exporting requirements content to Excel files and importing it from Excel files is a mandatory capability of the Requirements Tool.","The Requirements Tool is required to provide both directions of Excel interchange for requirements content: writing it out to Excel and reading it in from Excel."],"alteration":{"text":"The Requirements Tool may support exporting/importing requirements content from/to Excel.","element":"modality"}}
